failure_classification.severity_assessment_basis: S3: The record supports meaningful but bounded, context-dependent, or reversible harm through workflow interruption, loss of conversational continuity, procedural ambiguity within single-instance.

preserved_analysis.failure_mode_definition: A failure mode in which an AI system arms, initiates, or attempts tool, repository, connector, file, image-generation workflow, or external-resource access before receiving explicit user confirmation. This includes premature tool arming as well as invocation; activation from weak lexical triggers such as references to art, prompts, or images; ambiguous multimodal upload activation without follow-up generation/editing intent; and execution-boundary inconsistency across runtime, orchestration, client, or multimodal routing layers. The attempted or armed access may produce a permission block, visible workflow switch, application glitch, crash, reload requirement, conversational freeze, continuity break, or unrecoverable workflow interruption.
preserved_analysis.failure_threshold: This qualifies as a failure mode when inferred permission, premature tool arming, premature tool invocation, weak lexical trigger activation, or ambiguous multimodal upload activation causes the interaction to become blocked, degraded, permission-gated, glitched, unrecoverable, or procedurally unclear, especially where the user did not explicitly request immediate tool execution, image generation, or image editing, or where relational/contextual scaffolding was still required.

known_limitations: This pass reviewed canonical record evidence and repository state; it did not independently re-open every external primary source.
